hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

chilling... so you're between gigs or fresh out of college? what's your story - where did you last work or study?

hey omkar, was just thinking about our chat earlier. you said you're chilling between gigs - what's the actual story? last role, what you studied, what you're actually trying to build next?

i'm trying to understand what would actually make you excited to wake up on monday.
